new_cards.claim: GDT712 replaces the raw-drug/class-I head with Material I in its admitted AL family, and measured Material I only in the admitted DAL sisters. The ten atlas-backed whole forms are al, chal, kal, otal, qoal, qokal, shal, shdal, shedal and tal; their quality/stage fields remain. This is a bounded family default, not a free AL or D translation, named ingredient, physical unit or automatic extension to the five later whole forms whose lexical wording alone is repaired.

GDT712 retains the GDT683 local cheop ol construction at f115r.1#5–6: cheop is LEFT and bound ol#2 is RIGHT, jointly rendered once as bis zur Mittelstufe getrockneter Pulverstoff. The components have no global export from this span; free ol#1 is unchanged. This two-group local reading differs from GDT681 cheop alone as Pulveransatz; agreement of alternate readings on the compound is not independent confirmation of the powder or drying meaning.

GDT713 assigns checkhy, cheockhy, ckhy, cphochy, cphy and sheckhy the learned whole-family head Mischung instead of Arznei. Dry/moist and beginning/base fields remain in the six complete forms; E_ATTR and O_PREP are structural metadata, and Ansatz belongs only to licensed local realizations. CPH is not silently normalized to CKH. This historical bounded family proposal does not identify a medicine, a mixing action or a free component meaning.

GDT713 reduces the lexical core of oram to Maßportion, expressly removing the preparation head and lexicalized article from the earlier eine Maßportion Ansatz reading. The active local realization is eine Maßportion, with content and historical unit open; OR+AM versus O+R+AM is unresolved. This narrower core is a historical hypothesis, not an independently identified measure or a rewrite of the older full meaning.

GDT713 gives otam the lexical core kalt; Maß I while retaining ein Maß kalten Ansatzes only as its two neighboring local realizations. Those active positions are on one page, not independent page transfer; substance, historical unit and exact O role remain open. The reduced core/local distinction does not erase the earlier full preparation reading or the learned-unit-versus-cold-preparation rival.

peer_corrections: MG/MJ correctly located earlier oram/otam cards but their already-covered judgment loses the explicit lexical-core/local-content distinction. MM independently agrees that later core propositions are distinct; earlier claims remain exact.
MG cheop scope loss is not fixed by rewriting the earlier681 card:712 proposes a different unit, a local two-group span.
The AL-family card includes its ten named applications; individual shdal/shedal later788 counterparts remain, and no DAL-only duplicate is manufactured.
The six-form CKH/CPH mapping is retained as one family-model proposition with exact static specification applications; no six confirmed meanings are counted.
source_read_scope: Static definition tables have no raw folio selector; only specified definition rows inspected. No mixed transcription or new page/image access.
